Package dev.turboism.sdk.task

package dev.turboism.sdk.task
Plugin-scoped, bounded background task admission, cancellation, progress, and terminal outcomes.

Tasks run on runtime-owned workers subject to plugin policy, backpressure, circuit breaking, and time budgets. They are not a host-thread or UI-thread dispatch mechanism. Plugins must keep actions bounded and cooperatively honor their cancellation tokens.
